Kajabi doesn’t sell car tires or professional kitchen knives, and it doesn’t ship physical products. 
Kajabi’s Products are built for digital delivery (like courses, downloads, coaching, communities, etc.).
If you want to sell physical items, you can do it by embedding Shopify Buy Buttons on your pages or connecting a third-party fulfillment service (for example, Amazon) using Zapier.
There’s also a related feature request on our feedback portal about selling physical products/merch:
https://feedback.kajabi.com/feature-request/p/physical-product-merch-sales
